skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the roles and functions of travel service operations, including tour design, tour operation, and tour guiding.
Apply knowledge and skills in designing travel products and programs, including analyzing customer needs and pricing.
Manage and execute travel programs, including planning, coordination, and customer service.
Provide effective tour guiding and interpretation services, including script development and customer interaction.
Understand and implement customer service principles in travel operations.
Apply project management principles to the design and execution of travel programs.
Demonstrate adaptability and continuous learning in the travel industry.
Understand and adhere to professional ethics and responsibilities in the travel industry.

prerequisite_courses: Career Development in Tourism and Travel
